method: CSS box-model estimates, assuming one-line labels and standard font line metrics. Not browser/device measurements. The app checks actual root height including wrapped text; integration checks use independent synthetic heights.
safeguards: Pause retains layout space when hidden; status reserves the start/continue action height.
Numeric keys stay at least 44px high.
Settings and results remain in natural, scrollable document flow.
No page overflow clipping or forced viewport height. Zoom and exceptionally small views retain scrolling when necessary.
physical_phone_check: Check browser bars visible/hidden and standalone on the published v3.4; no physical-device test was performed.
